name: Wanwan Shiishii
source:
The protagonist is a down-on-his-luck student in a school for people with plans to work in the anime/otaku industry. One day while looking for something to eat, he has strange encounters with three young boys.

The protagonist's friend Chitoshi, an aspiring entrepreneur, had recently opened a maid cafe around the same time. She recruits the three boys to work there, with the protagonist as their supervisor.
translation:
主角是一所计划从事动漫/御宅族行业的学校的不幸学生。有一天，他在寻找吃的东西时，奇怪地遇到了三个小男孩。

主人公的朋友千岁，一位有抱负的企业家，最近大约在同一时间开设了一家女仆咖啡馆。她招募三个男孩在那里工作，主角担任他们的主管。
